article.title: -기는커녕: contraste y negación comparativa
article.part: Concesión y terminaciones finales — 양보와 종결 어미
article.chapter: Concesión, fondo y contraste avanzado — 양보·배경·고급 대조

claims.summary: The Ewha Korean 4 teaching reference describes A/V-기는커녕 as comparing the preceding content with what follows and emphasizing that the first expectation is far from the actual situation; it is mainly used in negative contexts.

The National Institute of Korean Language dictionary describes 커녕 as a postpositional particle written attached after nouns that emphasizes and negates the preceding expression in comparison with what follows, and also records an ‘not to mention, but rather’ sense.

Ewha Korean 4 presents 자주 만나기는커녕 바빠서 얼굴도 못 봐요 and 잘 보기는커녕 실수를 많이 해서 시험을 망쳤어요 as examples of the construction; the official dictionary gives noun-particle examples including 밥커녕 죽도 삼키기 힘들다 and 집안일커녕 누워서 꼼짝도 안 해.

The cited teaching and lexicographic examples support comparison, emphasis, and negation in these contexts, but do not establish that every use has one identical interpretation or that the construction is a neutral substitute meaning ‘instead of’.
